name: WriteRush –  AI-Powered Content Writer & Complete Social Media Assistant
author: Code Canel

sections.description:
Create authentic AI content in your brand voice. Generate blogs, social post captions & images – all from WordPress, without the tool-switching chaos.

WriteRush is the only WordPress plugin that has an inbuilt WordPress knowledge base to create content that actually sounds like you, not like generic AI.

This plugin is developed keeping the WordPress marketers in mind to make the day-to-day content creation process hassle-free.

This AI content marketing tool was developed by using OpenAI’s language model GPT-4o, and for image generation, the gemini-2.5-flash-image model was integrated.

Perfect for bloggers, freelancers, agencies, content marketers, and solopreneurs who want to create engaging and people-first content in the easiest way.

Visit the site – https://writerush.ai

🚀 Why WriteRush Is Different

The typical content generators give you tons of writing templates, but they do not serve the purpose. The generated content has no goal and lacks target audience knowledge.

This content could belong to anyone. As a writer, if you don’t like it, there’s no way you can regenerate it with AI. That needs hours of brainwork and human editing.

Until now, a proper content marketing tool has been missing in WordPress.
But with WriteRush, we have fixed this broken WordPress content workflow. It teaches the AI how you write, then generates content that maintains your unique tone, style, and personality. And here, with your prompt, you can regenerate the content as well. You can also generate related images here. No additional plugins needed.

✅ Your Voice, Not ChatGPT’s: Train on your existing content
✅ Complete Workflow: Blogs + images + social posts in one place
✅ WordPress-Native: Never leave your dashboard
✅ Strategic, Not Generic: SERP research + guided workflows
✅ No Prompt Engineering: We built the prompts for you

🎯 Core Features

📝 AI Blog Creation with Guided Workflow

Unlike ChatGPT’s blank box, WriteRush walks you through a strategic process:

  • Topic Analysis – Discover content angles and related keywords
  • SERP Research – See what’s ranking and learn from competitors
  • AI-Powered Outlines – Get structured outlines based on top content
  • Section Editing – Regenerate individual sections without redoing the entire post
  • Smart Title Generator – Multiple SEO-friendly title options
  • AI Image Generation – Create custom images without leaving WordPress
  • One-Click Publishing – Send directly to WordPress posts save as draft

🎨 Brand Voice Training (The Game-Changer)

No more writing huge prompts to train your product or business. Train WriteRush to write like YOU in 3 ways:

  1. Text Snippets – Paste samples of your best writing
  2. File Upload – Import PDFs, Word docs, or text files
  3. WP IQ – Train using your published WordPress posts or pages

Create multiple brand voices for different tones: professional for blogs, casual for social media, and formal for client work.

📱 Social Media Content Manager

Now, you can generate social posts for your preferred platform and generate images along with them.

🖼️ AI Image Generation

  • Generate custom images from text descriptions
  • Regenerate until you get the perfect image
  • Saves directly to WordPress Media Library

💡 Use Cases

For Bloggers & Content Creators:
→ Create consistent content without losing your unique voice
→ Turn one blog into multiple social posts
→ Build content libraries faster

For Digital Agencies:
→ Train separate brand voices for each client
→ Scale content production without hiring more writers
→ Maintain brand consistency across all deliverables

For Marketing Teams:
→ Centralize content creation in WordPress
→ Eliminate tool-switching between platforms
→ Maintain brand voice across all channels

🎁 Free Version Includes

✅ 2 blog posts
✅ 3 social media posts
✅ 2 AI-generated images
✅ 25 AI credits
✅ No time limit – test at your own pace

Premium Features

✅ Brand Voice

Upcoming Features

✅ Multi-post social media campaign
✅ Social post scheduler
✅ Elementor integration
✅ Product module

🔌 External Services & Requirements

WriteRush connects to external AI services to generate content. You must create a free account at https://app.writerush.ai to obtain a license key..

🛠️ Compatibility

✅ WordPress 5.8 or higher
✅ Elementor support (coming soon)
✅ Any WordPress theme
✅ Multisite compatible

🌍 Supported Languages

Create content in 15+ languages, including:
Spanish, Hindi, Bengali, German, Portuguese, Turkish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Arabic, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian, Ukrainian

  • Documentation

sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “WriteRush”
  3. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  4. Go to WriteRush settings
  5. Create an account at https://app.writerush.ai
  6. Copy your license key and paste it into settings
  7. Click “Activate License”
  8. Start creating content!
sections.faq:
Is WriteRush really free?

Yes. The free plan includes 2 blog posts, 3 social media posts, and 2 AI images — with no expiry or time limit.

Do I need an account to use WriteRush?

Yes. You need a free account at app.writerush.ai to obtain a license key. This key is required for authentication and tracking your AI usage quota.

Does WriteRush work with my theme or page builder?

Yes. WriteRush works with all WordPress themes. Elementor support is coming soon.

Is my content stored on external servers?

No. All generated content and images are saved directly to your WordPress site (database and Media Library).
Only the necessary prompts are sent to AI services during generation — nothing is stored externally after processing.

What data does WriteRush collect?

We send:
– License key (for authentication)
– Content prompts
– AI generation parameters

We DO NOT send:
– WordPress passwords
– User emails or personal data
– Database content
– Visitor/analytics data

For full details, please review our policies:
* Terms of Service: Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy: Privacy Policy

Is my WordPress password sent to WriteRush servers?

No. Your WordPress credentials are never accessed or transmitted. WriteRush only uses your license key for authentication.

Can I use WriteRush without the internet?

No. An active internet connection is required to communicate with OpenAI, SerpApi, Gemini, and other AI services.

Can I edit generated content?

Absolutely. All generated blogs, outlines, titles, social posts, and images are fully editable before publishing.

How do I get support?

  • Documentation: https://writerush.ai/documentation/
  • Video Tutorials: YouTube Channel
  • Support Portal: https://writerush.ai/support-policy/
  • Community: Facebook Page

Is WriteRush GDPR compliant?

Yes. WriteRush includes:
* Privacy policy links in all forms
* Unsubscribe options
* Data anonymization
* No unnecessary tracking
* User consent mechanisms
